The food is a single corn cob segment, seen end-on, sitting on a square plate roughly 26 cm across. The segment measures about 100 px across against a plate width of about 350 px, which works out to roughly 7 cm in diameter. Its length is probably 3–4 cm.

A piece that size would weigh about 80–100 g including the cob. Corn on the cob runs about 90 kcal per 100 g, or about 100 kcal for the segment. The cob itself is not eaten, but it is part of the visible food mass, so I'm counting it. There are also a few stray kernels, which add very little.

Estimate: about 90 g and about 85 kcal.
